mapper.sql: id, region_code, region_name, status, phase, progress, message, source_url, file_bytes, feature_count, CAST(layer_counts AS text) AS layer_counts, trigger_type, started_at, finished_at, error
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_job SET status = 'FAILED', phase = 'FAILED', error = '服务重启，任务已中断', message = '服务重启，任务已中断', finished_at = now() WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingest_job (region_code, region_name, status, phase, progress, message, source_url, trigger_type, started_at) VALUES (#{regionCode}, #{regionName}, 'RUNNING', 'DOWNLOAD', 0, '任务已创建，准备下载', #{sourceUrl}, #{triggerType}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE ingest_job SET status = 'SUCCESS', phase = 'SUCCESS', progress = 100, message = #{message}, feature_count = #{featureCount}, layer_counts = CAST(#{layerCounts} AS jsonb), finished_at = now(), error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ingest_job SET status = 'FAILED', phase = 'FAILED', message = #{message}, error = #{message}, finished_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingest_job_log (job_id, phase, level, message) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{phase}, #{level}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ingest_job ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ingest_job ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
